summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of Career Blueprint AI — backend (12 pytest tests, 100% pass) and frontend funnel (landing -> questionnaire -> result -> mock payment -> full report -> PDF). All critical flows working as expected. One minor copy/grammar issue found in AI-generated personality insight.

issues: Grammar: text reads 'You are a analytical strategist...' — should be 'an analytical' (vowel article). The phrase appears to be from ai_engine.py personality_insight template/string formatting. Worth fixing in the template (use 'an' before vowel-initial words or rephrase).

action_items: (Optional / minor) Fix grammar: 'a analytical strategist' -> 'an analytical strategist' in /app/backend/ai_engine.py personality insight template.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PAYMENT_MODE evaluated only once at import time — fine for current static config, but if you ever rotate keys at runtime you'd need to re-evaluate. Acceptable for MVP.
PaymentModal.jsx: stage 'loading' delays the appearance of method buttons; tests must wait. Consider rendering method skeletons during loading for better UX feedback.
ResultPreview.jsx LockedRow: uses static 78% bar — fine since it is blurred placeholder, but consider varying widths so it doesn't look uniformly identical.
Backend: /api/analyze does not strictly validate email format (Pydantic 'str' rather than EmailStr). Currently relies on frontend regex. Low risk but consider EmailStr.
No rate limiting on /api/analyze — could be hit repeatedly to flood DB with leads. Consider basic IP/email throttling in production.
All routes use the /api prefix correctly; CORS configured via env; MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded with projection {_id: 0}. Good.
